resources.string: Enter an IPv4 address such as 169.254.0.42.
This address cannot be used on a network link.
This is the network address of the subnet; choose another host address.
This is the broadcast address of the subnet; choose another host address.
Enter an IPv4 address such as 169.254.0.1.
This address cannot be used on a network link.
This is the network address of the subnet; choose another host address.
This is the broadcast address of the subnet; choose another host address.
The client needs a different address than the phone.
The client address must be in the same subnet as the phone address.
Enter a prefix length from 16 to 30.
Android\'s DHCP server accepts only /16 to /30. Use /16 for the largest network.
Above /30 there is no room for two addresses. Use /30 or less.
These are public internet addresses. Use them only if you know the device needs them.
These addresses are reserved for documentation, testing or carrier networks.
This subnet overlaps a network the phone already uses, which can break that connection.
